description: Search memories with strength-weighted ranking. Returns immediately with job_id and status queued; work runs on the plugin worker.
embedding_description: Queue semantic recall with optional top_k, memory_type, archived, tag and exclusion filters. Returns job_id and status queued before embedding or search runs. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result contains the original memories and count response, and failures also retain job.error.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued job handle with job_id and status; the final response is stored in job.result.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain this exact job_id. Schedule job_service::get_job while queued or processing; inspect terminal result or error before using the final data. Do not repeat a write because a poll is delayed.
